book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Wɔndiɑ wɔkurun ɡɑri
Yesu kpɑm nɛɛ, tɔ̃ɔ te, tɑ̀ n nɑ, Gusunɔn bɑndun ɡɑri yi ko n kɑ wɔndiɑ wɔkuru ɡɑrun ɡɑri weenɛ be bɑ ben fitilɑnu suɑ bɑ yɑrɑ bɑ kurɔ kpɑon durɔ sennɔ dɑ.
Ben nɔɔbu bɑ lɑɑkɑri mɔ, nɔɔbu mɑɑ bɑ ǹ lɑɑkɑri mɔ.
Nɔɔbu be bɑ ǹ lɑɑkɑri mɔ bɑ ben fitilɑnu suɑ bɑ ǹ ɡum kusenu kue.
Adɑmɑ be bɑ lɑɑkɑri mɔ mi, bɑ fitilɑnu suɑ, bɑ mɑɑ ɡum kusenu kuɑ.
Nɡe mɛ kurɔ kpɑon durɔ tɛɛmɔ, wɔndiɑ wɔku te, tɑ dom yĩbirimɔ tɑ dweeyɑmɔ.
Wɔ̃kurun bɔnu ɡoo u ɡbɑ̃rɑ u nɛɛ, kurɔ kpɑon durɔ wee, i yɑrimɑ i wi sennɔ dɑ.
Yerɑ wɔndiɑ wɔku te, tɑ seewɑ tɑ ten fitilɑnu sɔnwɑ.
Be bɑ ǹ lɑɑkɑri mɔ mi, bɑ beɔnɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, i sun ɡum kɛ̃ domi bɛsɛn fitilɑnu ɡbiɔ.
Lɑɑkɑriɡii be, bɑ wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑɑwo domi n ǹ koo bɛsɛ kpuro turi. I yɑnde doo i bɛɛɡim dwe.
Sɑɑ ye bɑ dwem dɑ mɑ kurɔ kpɑon durɔ u tunumɑ. Be bɑ sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ sibɑ duɑ kurɔ kpɑɑ yerɔ kɑ wi sɑnnu mɑ bɑ ɡɑmbo kɛnuɑ.
Yen biruwɑ wɔndiɑ be bɑ tie bɑ tunumɑ bɑ nɔɔɡiru suɑ bɑ nɛɛ, yinni ɑ sun kɛniɔ.
Adɑmɑ kurɔ kpɑon durɔ nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, nɑ ǹ bɛɛ yɛ̃.
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i n swɑɑ mɛɛrɑ, domi i ǹ tɔ̃ɔ te kɑ sɑɑ ye yɛ̃.
Yobu itɑn ɡɑri
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, win nɑɑrun ɡɑri yi ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe durɔ ɡoon ɡɑri wi u kĩ u wuu dɑ. U win yobu sokɑ u bu win dukiɑ nɔmu sɔndiɑ.
U turo ɡobi bɛkɛ ɡɛɛn subɑ nɔɔbu wɛ̃, turo mɑɑ subɑ yiru, itɑse sube teeru. U bu wɛ̃ wɛ̃ nɡe mɛ ben bɑɑwuren dɑm nɛ, mɑ u doonɑ.
Yoo wi bɑ subɑ nɔɔbu wɛ̃ mi, u yɑnde seewɑ u kɑ ɡobi yi tenkuru kuɑ, mɑ u mɑɑ nɔɔbu kpɑɑ ɑre wɑ.
Wi bɑ mɑɑ subɑ yiru wɛ̃ u kuɑ nɡe mɛ, mɑ u mɑɑ yiru kpɑɑ ɑre wɑ.
Adɑmɑ wi bɑ sube teeru wɛ̃ mi, u dɑ u wɔru ɡbɑ u win yinnin ɡobi yi sikuɑ.
Sɑnɑm dɔɔ sɑnɑm wee, yoo ben yinni u wurɑmɑ mɑ u kɑ ben bɑɑwure win ɡobi dooru kuɑ.
Yoo wi bɑ subɑ nɔɔbu wɛ̃ u nɑ kɑ subɑ nɔɔbu kpɑɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, ɡobi yin subɑ nɔɔbuwɑ ɑ mɑn wɛ̃. N wee, nɔɔbu kpɑɑ ye nɑ ɑre di.
Win yinni nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ nun siɑrɑ, wunɛ yoo ɡeo kɑ nɑɑnɛɡiiwɑ. A kuɑ nɑɑnɛɡii ɡɑ̃ɑ piiminu sɔɔ, kon nun ɡɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑnu nɔmu sɔndiɑ. A nɑ su yɛ̃ɛri.
Wi bɑ mɑɑ subɑ yiru wɛ̃ u nɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, ɡobi yin subɑ yiruwɑ ɑ mɑn wɛ̃, n wee yiru kpɑɑ ye nɑ ɑre di.
Win yinni nɛɛ, nɑ nun siɑrɑ wunɛ yoo ɡeo kɑ nɑɑnɛɡiiwɑ. A kuɑ nɑɑnɛɡii ɡɑ̃ɑ piiminu sɔɔ, kon nun ɡɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑnu nɔmu sɔndiɑ. A nɑ su yɛ̃ɛri.
Yen biru yoo wi bɑ sube teeru wɛ̃ mi, u nɑ u nɛɛ, yinni nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ wunɛ tɔn sɛ̃sɔɡiiwɑ. Mi ɑ ǹ duure miyɑ ɑ rɑ ɡbe, mi ɑ ǹ mɑɑ yɛ̃ke, miyɑ ɑ rɑ ɡɛ̃.
Bɛrum mɑn mwɑ mɑ nɑ dɑ nɑ wunɛn ɡobi beruɑ temɔ. N wee wunɛnyɑm.
Win yinni nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wunɛ yoo kɔ̃so kɑ yikurowɑ. N ǹ ɑ yɛ̃ mɑ nɑ rɑ ɡbe mi nɑ ǹ duure? Kpɑ n ɡɛ̃ mi nɑ ǹ yɛ̃ke?
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, n dɑɑ weenɛwɑ ɑ nɛn ɡobi ɡoo wɛ̃ kɑ nim kɛ̃ru, sɑnɑm mɛ nɑ wumɑ kpɑ n nɛnyɑm wɑ kɑ ɑre.
I nùn sube tee te mwɑɑrio kpɑ i wɔkuruɡii wi wɛ̃.
Domi wi u mɔ, win mɔru sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo nùn sosiɑ kpɑ u n mɔ n kpɑ̃, ɑdɑmɑ wi u kun mɔ, fiiko ye u mɑm mɔ bɑ koo nùn ye mwɑɑri.
Yoo kɑm wi mɑɑ, i nùn kɑsɑ koowo tɔɔwɔ mi u koo wiru nɔmɑ sɔndi yɑm wɔ̃kuru sɔɔ u swĩ.
Siri dɑ̃ɑkibu
Mɑ Yesu nɛɛ, sɑnɑm mɛ Tɔnun Bii u koo nɑ kɑ win yiiko bɑkɑ, kɑ wɔllun ɡɔrɑdobɑ kpuro, u koo sinɑ win sinɑ ɡɔni yiikoɡiɑn wɔllɔ.
Hɑnduniɑn bwesenu kpuro nu ko n mɛnnɛ win wuswɑɑɔ, kpɑ u tɔmbu wunɑnɑ nɡe mɛ yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro rɑ yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ bonu wunɑnɛ.
U koo yɑ̃ɑnu yi win nɔm ɡeuɔ, bonu mɑɑ win nɔm dwɑrɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ sunɔ u koo be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ win nɔm ɡeuɔ sɔ̃ u nɛɛ, i nɑ bɛɛ be nɛn Bɑɑbɑ u domɑru kuɑ, i bɑndu tubi dio te bɑ bɛɛ sɔɔru kuɑ sɑɑ hɑnduniɑn toren di.
Domi ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ mɑn kuɑ mɑ i mɑn dĩɑnu wɛ̃ nɑ di. Nim nɔru ɡɑ mɑn kuɑ mɑ i mɑn nim kɑ̃ nɑ nɔrɑ. Nɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɔɔ mɑ i mɑn dɑm koosiɑ.
Nɑ wɑ̃ɑ tereru, mɑ i mɑn biru wukiri. Nɑ bɑrɔ mɑ i mɑn nɔɔri. Nɑ wɑ̃ɑ pirisɔm sɔɔ mɑ i mɑn berɑm dɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ ɡemɡii be, bɑ koo nùn wisi bu nɛɛ, Yinni, dommɑ sɑ wɑ ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ nun mɔ̀ sere sɑ nun dĩɑnu wɛ̃, ǹ kun mɛ nim nɔru ɡɑ nun mɔ̀ mɑ sɑ nun nim kɑ̃.
Dommɑ sɑ nun sɔru mwɑ ǹ kun mɛ dommɑ sɑ nun wɑ tereru mɑ sɑ nun biru wukiri.
Dommɑ sɑ nun wɑ ɑ bɑrɔ, ǹ kun mɛ ɑ wɑ̃ɑ pirisɔm dirɔ, mɑ sɑ nun berɑm dɑ.
Sunɔ u koo bu wisi u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, mɛn nɔ i bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ benin turo ye kuɑ nɛnɑ i kuɑ.
Yen biru sunɔ u koo win nɔm dwɑruɡibu sɔ̃ u nɛɛ, i tii ɡɑwo nɛn bɔkun di, bɛɛ be Gusunɔ u bɔ̃rusi. I doo dɔ̃ɔ wi u ku rɑ ɡbi sɔɔ wi bɑ sɔɔru kuɑ Setɑm kɑ win ɡɔrɑdobɑn sɔ̃.
Domi ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ mɑn kuɑ, i ǹ mɑn dĩɑnu wɛ̃ nɑ di. Nim nɔru ɡɑ mɑn kuɑ, i ǹ mɑn nim kɑ̃ nɑ nɔrɑ.
Nɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɔɔ, i ǹ mɑn dɑm koosie. Nɑ wɑ̃ɑ tereru, i ǹ mɑn biru wukiri. Nɑ bɑrɔ, nɑ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ pirisɔm dirɔ, i ǹ mɑn nɔɔri.

Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ be, bɑ koo mɑɑ nɛɛ, Yinni, dommɑ sɑ nun wɑ ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ nun mɔ̀, ǹ kun mɛ nim nɔru ɡɑ nun mɔ̀, ǹ kun mɛ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɔɔ, ǹ kun mɛ ɑ wɑ̃ɑ tereru, ǹ kun mɛ ɑ bɑrɔ, ǹ kun mɛ ɑ wɑ̃ɑ pirisɔm dirɔ, mɑ sɑ ǹ nun somi.
Sunɔ u koo bu wisi u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, mɛn nɔɔ i ǹ bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ benin turo ye kue, nɛnɑ i ǹ ye kue.
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, beniwɑ bɑ koo dɑ mi sɛɛyɑsiɑ bi bu ku rɑ kpe bu wɑ̃ɑ, ɡemɡibu mɑɑ, wɑ̃ɑru te tɑ ku rɑ kpe sɔɔ.
